description: All 84 Ceiba listings offline, with market math, comps, and change tracking over a local mirror.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

tools.name: development_get
tools.description: Get one development by WordPress post ID. Required: id. Returns the Development.

tools.name: development_list
tools.description: List developments. Optional: per_page (default: 100), page. Returns array of Development.

tools.name: district_list
tools.description: List district and town terms (parent 0-style district parents 47-52; towns as children). Optional: per_page (default: 100), fields, page. Returns array of District.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-based); the district taxonomy has 106 terms, so page 2 completes the list

tools.name: featured-listing_get
tools.description: Get one listing by WordPress post ID (title, slug, description content, taxonomies, media reference). Required: id. Returns the FeaturedListing.

tools.name: featured-listing_list
tools.description: List Ceiba listings (search, sort, and taxonomy-ID filters; all 84 fit in one per_page=100 page). Optional: per_page (default: 100), page, search (plus 6 more). Returns array of FeaturedListing.

params.name: search
params.description: Keyword search across listing title and content

params.name: district
params.description: District/town taxonomy term ID (parent IDs 47-52 are districts; children are towns; see district list)

params.name: featured_tags
params.description: Status tag term ID to require (31=Ceiba Spotlight, 32=Under Contract; see featured-tag list)

params.name: featured_tags_exclude
params.description: Status tag term ID to exclude (30 excludes Sold listings)

tools.name: featured-tag_list
tools.description: List status tags with term IDs and counts. Optional: per_page (default: 100), page. Returns array of FeaturedTag.

tools.name: listing-page_detail
tools.description: Fetch a listing detail page's extracted content and links (price, specs, gallery, map, similar listings live in the page HTML). Required: slug. Returns the html.

tools.name: listing-page_our-listing
tools.description: Extract listing-card links from the Our Listings page. Returns the html.

tools.name: media_get
tools.description: Get one media item (source_url, alt text, dimensions). Required: media_id. Returns the Media.

novel_features.name: Change digest
novel_features.description: See new listings, price drops, and status flips since a prior sync — a Saturday-morning scan of the whole catalog.

novel_features.name: Price-per-acre leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank budget-filtered listings by price per acre, cheapest first.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side compare
novel_features.description: Aligned feature table for 2-4 named listings in one call.

novel_features.name: Comparables with deltas
novel_features.description: Nearest peer listings for one property, with price and per-acre deltas; sold comps opt-in.

novel_features.name: District market report
novel_features.description: Counts, median price, median price per acre, and status mix for a district and its towns.

novel_features.name: Mirror coverage report
novel_features.description: Per-field fill rates across mirrored listings so operators know which answers the mirror can currently support.
